title: Stephen
description: Stephen is a 2025 Indian Tamil-language psychological crime thriller film directed by Mithun Balaji in his directorial debut and produced by Jayakumar and Mohan produce the film under the JM Production House banner. The film stars Gomathi Shankar in the titular role alongside Michael Thangadurai and Smruthi Venkat in pivotal roles. The film marks the debut of Gomathi Shankar in the lead role, who had earlier appeared in supporting roles in films such as Dharala Prabhu (2020), Gargi (2022), and Lover (2024). Apart from acting, Shankar has also contributed as a writer along with Mithun.
